concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 tasks T005–T007 and 'Execution order' paragraph
concerns.text: The doc states "T005/T006/T007 touch different output files and can run in parallel once T004 completes," yet none of these tasks carries the `[P]` tag defined in the Task format section ("`[P]` = different files, no dependencies"). The parallel-safety claim and the tagging convention disagree; either tag T005–T007 `[P]` or drop the parallel claim so the deterministic ordering tooling and human readers agree.
